AMD Ryzen 5 5500 Desktop Processor (6 Cores, 12 Threads, Up to 4.2GHz)

Boost your gaming builds and daily multitasking productivity with the AMD Ryzen 5 5500 Desktop Processor. Available at Turbo Computer, this highly efficient AM4 socket hardware component is meticulously crafted for budget gamers and mainstream PC builders across Egypt who want unmatched price-to-performance value. Operating on the high-tier Zen 3 structural layout, it delivers incredible processing speeds for a complete system hardware modification or standard desktop configuration.

The AMD Ryzen 5 5500 features a robust core setup with 6 processing cores and 12 threads, clocking at a solid base speed of 3.6GHz and pushing up to a maximum boost frequency of 4.2GHz. Outfitted with 19MB of total combined cache (L2+L3), it minimizes data execution tracking latency for fluid frame rates. Please Note: This processor does not include integrated graphics and requires a discrete/dedicated graphics card layout setup to display video output.
